notes: Generated project data lives under projects/<project>/<stage>/, never inside skill folders.
A skill's output must exactly match the next skill's input.
upstream and downstream mirror the 'Depends on / feeds into' line in each SKILL.md.
All input and output strings are exact repository paths; ' + ' separates multiple exact paths.

voiceover_captions_split_proposal.problem: The legacy 'voiceover-captions' skill does two jobs: audio generation and caption timing generation.
voiceover_captions_split_proposal.decision: Keep it as legacy compatibility until voiceover-generator and caption-maker are built.

caption-maker.job: Create word/phrase caption timings and safe-zone-ready caption data only.

voiceover-captions.migration: When both target skills are built, keep this skill as a thin wrapper that calls both, then deprecate it.
